This is my FAVORITE memory of Frankie Beverly. It’s 4 am on April 8, 2017 on the Tom Joyner Fantastic Voyage Cruise. Frankie was sitting in the corner with other members of Maze and was about to head to his room. Then the DJ puts on “Before I Let Go.” I was filming some other stuff and handed someone my camera to capture this amazing memory. It was 🔥. Frankie was my main man! Video credit: Roland S.
